# ComplyEasy AI

ComplyEasy AI is an AI-powered compliance automation platform that helps organizations
achieve and maintain readiness across major security, privacy, and AI-governance
frameworks. It combines AI evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, risk and
vendor management, and audit preparation in a single workspace. The platform helps teams
reach compliance outcomes faster while keeping a verifiable, audit-ready record.

## What it is

ComplyEasy AI is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform that automates the
repetitive work of compliance: collecting evidence, monitoring controls, generating
policies, assessing risk, and preparing for audits. It is built for continuous compliance
rather than point-in-time assessments.

## Who it's for

- Startups and SMBs pursuing their first SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification.
- Growing companies managing multiple overlapping frameworks at once.
- Mid-market organizations and MSPs running compliance programs at scale.
- Enterprises and regulated entities with AI-governance and EU regulatory obligations.

## Frameworks supported

ComplyEasy AI helps customers achieve and maintain readiness for, among others:

- SOC 2 (Type I and Type II)
- ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 / ISO 42001
- GDPR
- HIPAA
- PCI DSS
- NIST CSF and NIST AI RMF (AI 600-1)
- EU AI Act
- DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act)
- DMA (Digital Markets Act) and DSA (Digital Services Act)
- EU CRA, CSRD, Ecodesign, and NIS2
- US state privacy laws

## Key capabilities

- AI evidence collection — gather and map evidence to controls automatically.
- Continuous monitoring — detect control drift and surface issues in real time.
- Risk management — identify, score, and track risks with treatment workflows.
- Vendor risk — assess and monitor third-party and supply-chain risk.
- Policy generation — draft and maintain policies aligned to chosen frameworks.
- Audit readiness — assemble audit-ready packages and track remediation.
- Agentic automation — autonomous compliance workflows for ongoing operations.
